spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/outdoor-store/issues/37. Source revision: 2026-09-28T10:05:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Add health endpoints and OpenTelemetry to the host
tasks.body:
Add liveness and readiness health endpoints and the Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry distro to `src/Contoso.Outdoor.Web.Core`; readiness checks the database, not the legacy app.

## Acceptance criteria
- The health endpoints answer from the new host and are never forwarded to the legacy app.
- Requests, dependencies and exceptions, including forwarded requests, appear in Application Insights.
- No secret is added to configuration.

tasks.title: Provision monitoring and health probes
tasks.body:
Add Log Analytics and workspace-based Application Insights to `infra/`, pass the connection string to the container app and configure liveness and readiness probes.

## Acceptance criteria
- `azd provision --preview` shows only the monitoring resources and the container app change.
- Probes use the host's health endpoints.
- No secret is added to parameters or workflows.

tasks.title: Roll out through a labelled staging revision
tasks.body:
Switch the container app to multiple-revision mode; the deploy workflow creates a revision without traffic, smoke-tests it through a `staging` label, then moves traffic and keeps the previous revision for rollback.

## Acceptance criteria
- A failed smoke test leaves all traffic on the previous revision.
- Rollback is one documented workflow run.
- Deploys still authenticate with OIDC.
